subject: Request for one-off concession and credit package after June latency spikes
messages:
From: Alex Green <alex.green@helix.ai>
To: support@redwood.com
Cc: tina.su@helix.ai, legal@helix.ai
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sustained latency spikes June 1–2 impacting production inference

Hi Redwood support,

Our platform started seeing elevated tail latency across several endpoints during peak traffic windows on June 1 and 2. We attached a short heatmap and the SLO export. This resulted in ~0.4% additional error/broken requests for our customers and some timeouts in our real-time workflows — enough for us to miss internal SLAs.

Can you confirm root cause, timeline, and tell us what remediation/credit options are available? This is material for our release next week.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Green
Head of Platform, Helix.ai

Attachments: traffic-heatmap.png, helix_slo_report_june.pdf

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Alex Green <alex.green@helix.ai>
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sustained latency spikes June 1–2 impacting production inference

Hi Alex — thanks for the report and the artifacts. I’m sorry for the disruption. We’re already tracking a regression caused by a mis-sized autoscaler job that rolled out into the US-west pool and caused delayed provisioning under the observed burst profiles.

Immediate steps we’ve taken:
- Rolled back the autoscaler change and pinned Helix workload to the dedicated burst pool.
- Hotfix deployed to speed up node attach for scaled-up replicas.
- Running a retro and will provide a factual incident timeline and mitigations by EOD Friday.

For remediation: our Customer Success (Monica) has prepared a proposed concession package which includes a one-month credit of Dedicated capacity and a usage discount for June invoices. Before I send the formal offer, I need approval from our revenue/exec team for a one-off credit outside standard SLO table and a temporary waiver of the late-notice clause in the SLA.

I’ll escalate internally now and loop you back with the proposed wording. Again — apologies and we’ll make sure Helix has priority handling while we stabilize.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: proposed-credit-sheet.xlsx

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 08:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Exec approval request — Helix one-off credit and SLA waiver

Team — quick summary and ask: Helix.ai (HS-48293) experienced a measurable SLO impact Jun 1–2 tied to our autoscaler rollout. CSM Monica has draft concession terms (attached):
- One free month of Dedicated capacity (estimated $42k list value)
- 30% discount applied to June invoice for usage billed (cumulative cap $25k)
- Temporary waiver of the 30-day notice provisioning clause for the next 90 days to allow Helix to move more traffic during recovery.

Risks: sets a precedent for a mid-market account; legal needs to approve waiver language. Financial asks: authorization to issue a one-time credit up to $50k and let the CSM apply the discount.

Requested approvals:
- Karthik: approval to offer the proposed financial package (credit + discount)
- Lauren: executive signoff to relax notice clause for this account for 90 days (legal to finalize text)

Attachments: proposed-credit-sheet.xlsx, helix_slo_report_june.pdf

Can I get a quick thumbs? Helix is pressing for wording this week.

—Eve

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec approval request — Helix one-off credit and SLA waiver

Eve — I approve the financial ask up to $50k. Rationale: Helix is a growing mid-market customer on a committed path; the outage was on our side and the cap keeps it bounded. Please ensure Finance posts the credit to next cycle and that we capture the concession as a one-off in the deal record.

Karthik
VP, Revenue Operations

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: legal@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 16:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec approval request — Helix one-off credit and SLA waiver

Understood. I will sign off on a one-time relaxation of the 30-day provisioning notice for Helix for a 90-day period, contingent on legal drafting an explicit amendment that includes rollback triggers and a non-precedent clause.

Conditions:
- Legal must include an explicit non-precedent clause and defined rollback triggers (e.g., sustained >0.5% SLO impact within a 7-day window).
- The financial credit must be recorded as a one-off contra-revenue line and not alter list pricing.

Once legal prepares the amendment and Finance confirms ledger treatment, Evelyn — you have the green light to present the concession to Helix and finalize wording.

Lauren Bishop
Chief Revenue Officer, Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Alex Green <alex.green@helix.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: tina.su@helix.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Proposed concession wording for Helix — ready for signature

Alex & team — following our internal approvals, here is the concession package for your review: 

1) One-month credit of Dedicated capacity equivalent to Helix’s committed pool for July 2027 (applied as a one-time invoice credit).
2) 30% usage discount applied to June 2027 bill up to a cap of $25,000.
3) Temporary waiver of the 30-day provisioning notice requirement for 90 days with rollback triggers; legal to send final amendment.

Attached: clean concession term sheet and the incident SLO export. If this looks good, we’ll route the amendment via DocuSign once legal finalizes text.

Thanks — Monica
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed-credit-sheet.xlsx, helix_slo_report_june.pdf

From: Alex Green <alex.green@helix.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: tina.su@helix.ai, legal@helix.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 17:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed concession wording for Helix — ready for signature

Monica — that package is acceptable in principle. Appreciate the clear next steps and the non-precedent language. Please route the amendment to legal@helix.ai and we’ll countersign once language is confirmed.

Thanks again for the quick response and the credit offer — helps for our Q3 launch confidence.

—Alex
